findings.claim: 10-K 稱多個served markets 面臨低成本製造地區新進入競爭者與市場整併，競爭加劇；管理層自認在多數市場居領導地位，但無法彙總衡量競爭地位。
findings.excerpt: We face increased competition in a number of our served markets as a result of the entry of competitors based in low-cost manufacturing locations, and increasing consolidation in particular markets.

findings.claim: 風險因素載明若無法有效競爭可能導致需求與市占下降並被迫降價；部分通路夥伴也銷售競爭對手產品。
findings.excerpt: We face intense competition and if we are unable to compete effectively, we may experience decreased demand and decreased market share. Even if we compete effectively, we may be required to reduce prices for our products and services.
